title: Training Record
description: Safety training completion record per OSHA-KR Articles 29, 31, 32, 114. Emergency-response (응급조치) education anchors to Article 29(3)-related provisions; the legacy Article 13 citation is invalid (current 제13조 = 기술·작업환경 표준 — see training-agent.md 2026-08-24 anchor correction).

contractor_flag.description: True if trainee is a subcontractor/contractor worker (도급·하도급 인력) — reverse-intake from contractor-safety-agent; SAPA Article 5 traceability

company_name.description: Trainee employer name (협력업체명) — required when contractor_flag=true

legal_basis.description: Multi-source legal basis. Primary: OSHA-KR Article 29 (worker safety education) or Article 29 §3 + 시행규칙 §26 (special education for hazardous work) or Article 32 (job education for safety/health management supervisors etc.) or Article 114 (MSDS education) or Article 36 (risk assessment communication). Adjacent laws may include: SAPA Article 4 (employer safety and health assurance obligation), SAPA Article 5 (contract/subcontractor safety obligations). Records contain worker PII (trainee_name, trainee_id, instructor_id, e_signature signer IDs) and MUST additionally cite PIPA (개인정보보호법): collection/use grounds (Art 15), minimum-necessary collection (Art 16), third-party provision restrictions (Arts 17-18), destruction after retention (Art 21) — see regulations/KR/PIPA.yaml.

agent_id.description: Optional: agent attribution (e.g., training-agent). Omit when unknown — zero-fabrication rule; must match audit_trail.created_by when an audit trail is present.

workflow_id.description: Optional: originating workflow execution (e.g., 'functional/training'). Never invent an ID to satisfy this field.
